name: TLS 1.3 Only (non-compliant with Intermediate)
description: Deploys an nginx server configured to accept only TLS 1.3 connections. Under the Intermediate profile (the default on non-OCP clusters), the server must accept all versions from TLS 1.2 upward. A TLS 1.3-only server rejects TLS 1.2 and is therefore non-compliant. This scenario verifies that overly restrictive servers are correctly flagged.

name: TLS 1.2 Only (non-compliant with Intermediate)
description: Deploys an nginx server configured to accept only TLS 1.2 connections with Intermediate-profile ciphers. Under the Intermediate profile, the server must accept all versions from TLS 1.2 through TLS 1.3. A TLS 1.2-only server rejects TLS 1.3 and is therefore non-compliant. This scenario exercises the above-minimum version check (Step 3).

name: TLS 1.2 Allowed (compliant with Intermediate profile)
description: Deploys an nginx server configured to accept both TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 connections, restricted to only the cipher suites allowed by the Intermediate TLS security profile. On non-OpenShift clusters (including CI), the test defaults to the Intermediate profile (min TLS 1.2). Since this server meets both the minimum version and cipher requirements, it is compliant. Note: this same server would be non-compliant under a Modern profile (which requires TLS 1.3), but that is covered by unit tests rather than CI scenarios.

name: Plain HTTP (compliant)
description: Deploys a plain HTTP server with no TLS configured. Non-TLS services are reported as informational only and are not considered a compliance failure. The test verifies that the certsuite does not penalize services that do not use TLS at all, since they are outside the scope of TLS version enforcement.

name: Unsecured container ports across nodes (non-compliant)
description: Deploys two plaintext HTTP pods with required hostname anti-affinity so they land on different nodes. networking-unsecured-container-ports must fail both pods as plaintext. A single plaintext failure with the other pod marked unreachable is the cross-node openssl flake this scenario guards against.

name: Secured container ports across nodes (compliant)
description: Deploys two TLS HTTP pods with required hostname anti-affinity so they land on different nodes. networking-unsecured-container-ports must pass, and both pods must be classified as using TLS. A pass with one pod marked unreachable is the cross-node openssl flake this scenario guards against.

name: Container port name http (compliant)
description: Deploys a container port named http, which follows the allowed port-name format.

name: Container port name sftp (non-compliant)
description: Deploys a container port named sftp, which is outside the allowed port-name formats.

name: Readiness probe defined (compliant)
description: Deploys a workload with a TCP readiness probe on nginx's listening port.

name: Readiness probe missing (non-compliant)
description: Deploys a workload without a readiness probe.

name: Liveness probe defined (compliant)
description: Deploys a workload with a TCP liveness probe on nginx's listening port.

name: Liveness probe missing (non-compliant)
description: Deploys a workload without a liveness probe.

name: Startup probe defined (compliant)
description: Deploys a workload with a TCP startup probe on nginx's listening port.

name: Startup probe missing (non-compliant)
description: Deploys a workload without a startup probe.

name: Default ingress and egress deny policy (compliant)
description: Deploys a NetworkPolicy with empty ingress and egress rules for the target pod. This checks API objects and rules only; it does not depend on packet enforcement.

name: NetworkPolicy missing egress deny (non-compliant)
description: Deploys a NetworkPolicy that selects the target pod and denies ingress but does not declare egress policy. This checks API objects and rules only; it does not depend on packet enforcement.

name: Image with explicit tag (compliant)
description: Deploys the multi-architecture nginx unprivileged image with an explicit 1.27 tag.

name: Image without explicit tag (non-compliant)
description: Deploys the same multi-architecture image without a tag, so the image reference resolves to latest but is reported as untagged.

name: Service account token automount disabled (compliant)
description: Deploys a pod with a dedicated service account whose service account token automount is disabled.

name: Service account token automount enabled (non-compliant)
description: Deploys a pod with a dedicated service account whose service account token automount is enabled.

name: Declared listening port (compliant)
description: Reuses the two-node plaintext listener workload and node-probe path. Both nginx pods declare the TCP port they listen on.

name: Undeclared listening port (non-compliant)
description: Reuses the two-node plaintext listener workload and node-probe path, but omits the container port declaration while nginx continues listening on TCP 8080.
